title: dryopteris angustifolia
intro: Dryopteris angustifolia, commonly known as Autumn fern, is a species of fern native to China, Japan, and Korea. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Autumn fern include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help to treat various health conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Autumn fern include flavonoids, terpenoids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
